data: dev set: first 20,260-30,000 docs of 17 Hugging Face raw shards (wikibooks 00000-00001, wikinews 00000, wikipedia 00000/00050/00093/00140/00186, wikiquote, wikisource 00000/00007/00013, wikiversity, wikivoyage, wiktionary 00000/00005/00010); 500,260 docs; 151,003 survive cleaning and quality filters (no book assembly) and were scored

english_share.method: letter-weighted share of body lines whose lid.176 top label is en; LaTeX math removed; each line is a segment; docs with < 100 letters are kept unscored

readings.0.00-0.10: read ~45: almost all non-English (Interlingue/Interlingua/Occidental/Esperanto/Malay/French texts, interwiki-title residue pages); a few language-teaching pages written almost wholly in the target language (Spanish exercise answer keys, Vietnamese numbers)
readings.0.10-0.20: read all 66: 41 English-intended (language lessons for English speakers, Wiktionary glosses with foreign citations, English articles with title lists), 14 non-English (conlang direct-method chapters, Esperanto reader pages, a German lab page, a Spanish quiz), 11 junk lists (Bengali book catalogue, bibliographies)
readings.0.10-0.30: read 30 more: majority English language-teaching pages
readings.0.30-0.50: read 30: mostly English (language lessons, Wikipedia genus articles with species lists, a Shulchan Aruch translation, Harveian oration, Elasticity with math); 0.5 would drop them

english_share.segmentation_choice: line segments instead of blank-line paragraphs: Wikiquote pages with original-language quotes moved from 0.1-0.5 to >= 0.5 (wikiquote docs below 0.5: 58 with paragraph segments, 4 with line segments)

stopword_fraction.method: fraction of whitespace words (math removed) in {the be to of and that have with a in is it for on as was by are this at from}

readings.0.00-0.03: read 22: Pokedex move lists, Han-character gloss entries, index pages, code specifications, subscriber lists, romanized Hakka drills
readings.0.03-0.06: read 25: mostly code, TOCs, constants lists, but also a kickboxer biography with a fight table and an electoral-history article
readings.0.06-0.10: read 22: Han-character entries, math-heavy proofs, catalogues, recipes
